prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. ONE original battle-ready enemy sprite illustration for industrial fantasy action RPG, M22 Molten-Mouth Foundry Worker from a powerless underground hangar. Strong PEAR-SHAPED silhouette: a huge asymmetrical thick-walled CRUCIBLE BELLY with an offset pouring lip makes most of its body, balanced on two small sturdy foundry feet; two short mechanical clamp hands sit on the crucible sides. The creature has no separate human head; a tiny hooded amber sensor sits on the upper rim. Thick ceramic-lined vessel is slightly tilted toward its projecting side pour spout, preparing to spill molten metal; show a restrained orange light reflecting inside the open inner wall, NOT a pouring stream, fire explosion or environment. A large crucible handle on the opposite side remains visible, providing a readable flanking landmark. Exposed hinge and locking crank, coal-black cast iron, ivory refractory ceramic lining, heat-dark copper rivets, patches of worn ochre enamel, subtle mineral-organic tendons powering short limbs. Original utility-machine creature anatomy, not a humanoid wearing a pot. Premium richly hand-painted stylized industrial-fantasy with beautiful broad forms, tactile materials, carefully placed warm highlights, readable painterly volumes and controlled wear. Elevated three-quarter camera looking down about 40 degrees showing the inner crucible and side lip. Entire subject, feet, handles and tiny arms framed with generous transparent safety margin. Near-opaque solid subject on genuine transparent alpha; silhouette readable as a lopsided pear at 70px. No ground, cast shadow, floor, platform, scenery, haze, UI, words, symbols, logos, watermark or existing franchise design.

alpha_validation.notes: Original generated alpha preserved; broad subject is nearly opaque. Boundary has only trace low-alpha generation noise, not opaque clipping.

visual_inspection: Large pear-shaped crucible body, offset pouring lip and short clamp arms match the identity.
Open refractory lining and opposite handle expose clear flanking landmarks.
Restrained internal molten glow; no attack stream or hazard baked into art.
production_status: Single battle-ready illustration. Full directional animation, attacks, recovery and 70-pixel in-engine visual QA remain separate deliverables.
